column1: AN  ACT  TO  PROMOTE STRATEGIC  DEVELOPMENT  PROJECTS  ;  TO

column2: PROVIDE  A  TAX  FREE  PERIOD  IN  RELATION  TO    IDENTIFIED
STRATEGIC  DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS ;  AND TO  PROVIDE FOR
MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

column1: BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Strategic Development

column1: Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008.

column2: From and after the date of the coming into operation of

column1: this Act, there shall be certain projects identified in accordance
with the following provisions contained herein, as Strategic
Development Projects for the purposes of this Act, to which
exemptions  from  the  applicability  of  the  provisions  of  the
enactments specified in the Schedule to this Act, may from
time to time be granted :

column2: Provided that the period of any exemption granted in terms

column1: of this section shall in no event exceed a period of twenty-five
years.

column2: (1) The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka established

column1: by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978,
shall identify in consultation with the relevant line Ministries,
any proposed project as a Strategic Development Project.

column2: (2) On a project being identified in terms of subsection (1)

column1: as a Strategic Development Project, the Minister in charge of
the subject of Investment shall by Notification published in
the Gazette publish the relevant information relating to each
proposed project and the exemptions to be granted in respect
of the same.
